paper.title: Quantum error correction below the surface code threshold

result.summary: 本文在超导量子处理器上实现了低于阈值的表面码量子纠错。作者在105量子比特处理器上运行距离-7表面码，在72量子比特处理器上运行距离-5表面码并集成实时解码器 [S1.p3]。距离-7逻辑量子比特的每周期逻辑错误率为0.143%±0.003%，错误抑制因子Λ=2.14±0.02，其寿命超过最佳物理量子比特2.4±0.3倍 [abstract]。作者还通过距离-29重复码探测到约每小时发生一次的关联错误事件，形成10^-10的错误下限 [S4.p3]。这些结果表明，若可扩展，该器件性能有望满足大规模容错量子算法的运行需求 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是实现低于阈值的量子纠错，即物理错误率低于临界阈值，从而使逻辑错误率随码距增加而指数抑制 [S1.p1]。原文指出，尽管许多平台展示了量子纠错的不同特征，但尚无量子处理器明确展示低于阈值的性能 [S1.p1]。此外，容错量子计算还要求系统在数小时时间尺度上保持稳定，并实时解码综合征信息 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: While many platforms have demonstrated different features of quantum error correction, no quantum processor has definitively shown below-threshold performance.
If the physical operations are below a critical noise threshold, the logical error should be suppressed exponentially as we increase the number of physical qubits per logical qubit.
These include features like stability over the hours-long timescales of quantum algorithms and the active removal of correlated error sources like leakage.
the syndrome information produced by the quantum device must be decoded as fast as it is generated.

method.text: 作者在105量子比特处理器上实现距离-7表面码，在72量子比特处理器上实现距离-5表面码并集成实时解码器 [S1.p3]。他们使用两种离线高精度解码器：神经网络解码器和增强匹配合成的关联最小权完美匹配解码器集成 [S2.p2]。实时解码采用基于Sparse Blossom算法的多线程流式解码器，使用恒定大小的图缓冲区和分块并行化 [S5.p2]。

evidence.quote: Using a 72-qubit processor, we implement a distance-5 surface code operating with an integrated real-time decoder.
using a 105-qubit processor with similar performance, we realize a distance-7 surface code.
One is a neural network decoder, and the other is a harmonized ensemble of correlated minimum-weight perfect matching decoders augmented with matching synthesis.
We employ a specialized version of the Sparse Blossom algorithm optimized to quickly resolve local configurations of errors common in surface code decoding
The decoder operates on a constant-sized graph buffer which emulates the section of the error graph being decoded at any instant

experiments.text: 作者在105量子比特处理器上运行距离-7表面码记忆实验，包含49个数据量子比特、48个测量量子比特和4个额外泄漏移除量子比特 [S2.p3]。在72量子比特处理器上，他们运行距离-29重复码，执行1000个纠错周期，共2×10^7次实验，总计2×10^10个纠错周期，耗时5.5小时 [S4.p2]。实时解码实验在距离-5表面码上进行，测试多达10^6个纠错周期 [S5.p3]。

evidence.quote: We operate a distance-7 surface code memory comprising 49 data qubits, 48 measure qubits, and 4 additional leakage removal qubits
we run a distance-29 repetition code for 1000 cycles of error correction over $2\times 10^{7}$ shots split evenly between bit- and phase-flip codes.
In total, we execute $2\times 10^{10}$ cycles of error correction comprising 5.5 hours of processor execution time.
For our distance-5 surface code, we test different problem sizes by increasing the number of error correction cycles up to $10^{6}$.

findings.text: 距离-7表面码的逻辑错误率为每周期0.143%±0.003%，错误抑制因子Λ=2.14±0.02，其寿命为291±6微秒，超过最佳物理量子比特寿命119±13微秒的2.4±0.3倍 [abstract][S2.p5][S2.p7]。实时解码在距离-5下保持低于阈值性能，平均解码延迟为63±17微秒，且不随实验长度增加而增长 [S5.p3][S5.p4]。距离-29重复码在d=5到11之间给出Λ=8.4±0.1，但在d≥15时出现偏离指数抑制，形成约10^-10的逻辑错误下限，由约每小时一次的关联错误爆发导致 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。

evidence.quote: culminating in a 101-qubit distance-7 code with 0.143% ± \pm 0.003% error per cycle of error correction.
With our neural network decoder, we observe $\Lambda=2.14\pm 0.02$ and $\varepsilon_{7}$ = $(1.43\pm 0.03)\times 10^{-3}$
The distance-7 logical qubit lifetime is $291\pm 6$ µs, exceeding the lifetimes of all the constituent physical qubits (median $85\pm 7$ µs, best $119\pm 13$ µs) by a factor of $2.4\pm 0.3$.
We observe that the average latency remains roughly constant at a net average of $63\pm 17$ µs independent of the length of the experiment (up to 1.1 seconds)
Our real-time decoder achieves $\varepsilon_{5}=0.35\%\pm 0.01\%$ and $\Lambda=2.0\pm 0.1$ using a device-data-independent prior.
we obtain an error suppression factor $\Lambda=8.4\pm 0.1$ when fitting logical error per cycle versus code distance between $d=5$ and 11
at code distances $d\geq 15$, we observe a deviation from exponential error suppression at high distances culminating in an apparent logical error floor of $10^{-10}$.
They occur approximately once an hour, rather than once every few seconds

limitations.text: 作者指出，尽管原则上可以通过扩展现有处理器实现低逻辑错误率，但在实践中资源消耗巨大；外推显示达到10^-6错误率需要距离-27逻辑量子比特，使用1457个物理量子比特 [S6.p3]。重复码实验识别出由关联错误爆发导致的10^-10噪声下限，其成因尚不清楚，缓解该机制对运行更大规模量子算法至关重要 [S6.p3][S4.p4]。此外，实时解码的延迟尚未包括反馈到逻辑电路的时间 [S5.p3]。

evidence.quote: Although we might in principle achieve low logical error rates by scaling up our current processors, it would be resource intensive in practice.
achieving a $10^{-6}$ error rate would require a distance-27 logical qubit using 1457 physical qubits.
Our repetition code experiments also identify a noise floor at an error rate of $10^{-10}$ caused by correlated bursts of errors.
We do not yet understand the cause of these events, but mitigating them remains vital to building a fault-tolerant quantum computer.
This latency will eventually determine the reaction time of the logical processor when enacting non-Clifford gates, but does not yet include feedback into the logical circuit.
